newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee up vs fwd dlr, slightly down in spot.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee up vs fwd dlr, slightly down in spot.

text.p: The Indian rupee was up against the forward dollar in late morning trade on Tuesday while it dipped from opening levels in the spot market, dealers said.
November-delivery dollars were quoted at a premium of 84/87 paise against Monday's close of 87/89.
"Forward premiums opened lower on easier call money and on expectations that liquidity will ease further," said a dealer at a state-run bank.
Call money was quoted at 7.75-8.25 percent in latest deals against Monday's close of 8.0-8.25.
Dealers said the rupee dipped slightly on demand from a large state-run bank in late morning.
The Indian rupee was quoted at 35.850/860 per dollar in latest deals after being stuck in a 35.83/84 range for most of the morning. It opened at 35.835/845.
